name: @sure/api-tests
description: End-to-end API tests: drive the real backend binary through the generated @sure/client.
//openapi-fetch: Must stay identical to packages/client's range, including its sub-0.17 cap — see the note there for the mechanism. Note that this package's own `tsc --noEmit` does pass on 0.17 (measured 2026-08-11): fixtures.ts imports the client by relative path (`../client/src/index`), so the copy that decides response types is the client's, and the client is where the tuple regression bites. Keeping the two ranges equal is what keeps a single openapi-fetch in the tree.
//@types/node: Tracks the Node major this repo runs, not npm `latest`. `engines.node` is ">=24" and every workflow in .github pins `node-version: 24`, so ^24 types against the runtime CI actually uses; `latest` is 26.x, which would let code typecheck against APIs Node 24 does not have. 24.13.3 is the newest 24.x. Raise this together with the Node pin, not on its own.
